_comment: Which Po repos share which CI/CD files. Every repo of a type holds an identical copy of the listed files and owns that copy (no shared repo or package). 'reference' only names the repo sync-ci.ps1 copies from and check-conventions.sh compares against; it is not a master copy. Since 2026-11-18 the dotnet-web deploy.yml is the Po web standard's build-and-deploy-only workflow. Files marked optional are only required when the repo has the 'when' path.
